Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The urine findings show significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, positive leukocyte esterase, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, consistent with a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and mild proteinuria may be secondary to infection. Low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. No casts detected. Clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy are recommended.
